subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Utilizar formas verbais do futuro para descrever planos e expectativas e fazer previsões.

components.description_pt: Formar o tempo futuro simples usando will mais um verbo no infinitivo
components.description_en: Form the simple future tense using will plus a base verb
components.cc_component_description: Form the simple future tense using will plus a base verb

components.description_pt: Usar going to para descrever planos e expectativas sobre o futuro
components.description_en: Use going to to describe plans and expectations about the future
components.cc_component_description: Use future-tense verbs correctly to describe actions yet to occur in writing

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre will e going to baseado no contexto comunicativo
components.description_en: Distinguish between will and going to based on communicative context
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between regular and irregular past tense verb forms in context

components.description_pt: Usar verbos no futuro corretamente para descrever ações ainda por ocorrer na escrita
components.description_en: Use future-tense verbs correctly to describe actions yet to occur in writing
components.cc_component_description: Use future-tense verbs correctly to describe actions yet to occur in writing

cc_matches.description: Use verbs to convey a sense of past, present, and future (e.g., Yesterday I walked home; Today I walk home; Tomorrow I will walk home).
Form and use the simple (e.g., I walked; I walk; I will walk) verb tenses.
Form and use the past tense of frequently occurring irregular verbs (e.g., sat, hid, told).
